notes: Both reliable endpoints run on one board; this is not a two-board benchmark.
Rates count useful bytes. Only passed runs have accepted throughput summaries.
Reliable mode does not observe UART error callbacks; complete payloads and lifecycle are checked.
Raw mode observes UART error callbacks and requires zero measured errors.
Startup errors are recorded separately before timed work.
Counters can straddle sample boundaries and are not an exact wire-loss estimate.
Compact source snapshot digests hash a sorted JSON path-to-SHA256 mapping, UTF-8 encoded with separators comma and colon and no whitespace.
The original full flash was restored and the complete on-device digest matched the backup.
